race.comment: Tough way to finish the day, but siding with the Croweater SANDASTAN (2), who has really found form the past couple. Was dominant at Coleraine and then only beaten three quarters of a length last start, when heavily backed. Gets the draw to play a key role here. GINGER SWEET (9) finally showed something last start, so should be at peak fitness now and while she is yet to win at this trip she's finished second in three of six starts. THE STOCK ROUTE (5) has been up for a while, but wasn't beaten far last start which showed he's holding together well. DUSTY'S DEEL (3) was ordinary last start but the two earlier runs this prep were encouraging and he'll be better for the run at 2000m. Can improve. PENDANTE (7) ran a better race last start when allowed to race up on speed, so might give them something to catch.
